content: LLM provider abstraction: never call a provider API directly from business logic; route through an internal seam that standardizes prompts, params, and response schemas. Seams leak when provider-specific concepts (tokenizer quirks, tool-call formats, streaming shapes, effort/model knobs) bleed through the unified interface. LiteLLM/AI gateways provide universal interfaces. Lock-in cost is migration effort when prices/perf/compliance change.
